cohort: The study included 15 patients treated for Pyridoxine-dependent epilepsy (PDE) identified across all Norwegian paediatric, neurological, and neurohabilitation departments and relevant professional societies.
finding: The study found a significantly higher prevalence of PDE-ALDH7A1 in children relative to adults, suggesting previous underdiagnosis and early mortality, and emphasized the imperative for lifelong, continuous pyridoxine treatment.
